configurations.name: Architect
configurations.descriptiveLine: Creating coherent direction through awareness, possibility, and action.
configurations.shortDescription: Creating coherent direction through awareness, possibility, and action.
configurations.profile: As an Architect, you naturally integrate reality, possibility, and action into a coherent approach for leading transformative change. You create clarity in moments of complexity by helping people and organizations connect systemic awareness, adaptive thinking, and courageous action toward a shared direction.
configurations.leadershipStory: As an Architect, you naturally integrate reality, possibility, and action into a coherent approach for leading transformative change. You create clarity in moments of complexity by helping people and organizations connect systemic awareness, adaptive thinking, and courageous action toward a shared direction.
configurations.howYouLead: Your leadership expands as you intentionally develop these same capacities in others, making transformative leadership a collective practice rather than an individual strength.
configurations.expandingLeadershipContribution: Your leadership expands as you intentionally develop these same capacities in others, making transformative leadership a collective practice rather than an individual strength.
configurations.helpOthers: Develop others to think systemically and lead collaboratively.
configurations.increaseLeadershipEffectiveness: Create more opportunities for others to lead transformation independently.
configurations.enduringQuestion: How am I helping others develop the same integrated leadership I bring naturally?

configurations.name: Accelerator
configurations.profile: As an Accelerator, you naturally approach leadership with curiosity, openness, and a desire to discover new possibilities. You lead by recognizing emerging opportunities, encouraging experimentation, and helping others move confidently toward new possibilities.
configurations.leadershipStory: As an Accelerator, you naturally approach leadership with curiosity, openness, and a desire to discover new possibilities. You lead by recognizing emerging opportunities, encouraging experimentation, and helping others move confidently toward new possibilities.
configurations.howYouLead: Your leadership expands as you ground emerging possibilities in a deeper understanding of reality, transforming bold ideas into meaningful and sustainable action.
configurations.expandingLeadershipContribution: Your leadership expands as you ground emerging possibilities in a deeper understanding of reality, transforming bold ideas into meaningful and sustainable action.
configurations.helpOthers: Expand how others think about what is possible.
configurations.increaseLeadershipEffectiveness: Slow down to understand the deeper context before acting.
configurations.enduringQuestion: What deeper patterns should I understand before taking my next step?

configurations.name: Advocate
configurations.descriptiveLine: Challenging inequitable patterns through courageous action.
configurations.shortDescription: Challenging inequitable patterns through courageous action.
configurations.profile: As an Advocate, you naturally recognize difficult realities and possess the courage to respond with purposeful action. You lead by confronting harmful patterns, encouraging accountability, and creating opportunities for meaningful systemic change.
configurations.leadershipStory: As an Advocate, you naturally recognize difficult realities and possess the courage to respond with purposeful action. You lead by confronting harmful patterns, encouraging accountability, and creating opportunities for meaningful systemic change.
configurations.howYouLead: Your leadership expands as you explore new possibilities alongside difficult realities, allowing courageous action to become both transformative and enduring.
configurations.expandingLeadershipContribution: Your leadership expands as you explore new possibilities alongside difficult realities, allowing courageous action to become both transformative and enduring.
configurations.helpOthers: Help people navigate ambiguity and complexity.
configurations.increaseLeadershipEffectiveness: Ask more questions before deciding on a course of action.
configurations.enduringQuestion: How might deeper curiosity strengthen the impact of my courage?

configurations.name: Connector
configurations.descriptiveLine: Building understanding that inspires meaningful action.
configurations.shortDescription: Building understanding that inspires meaningful action.
configurations.profile: As a Connector, you naturally bring people together to discover new possibilities through meaningful relationships. You lead by creating space for dialogue, building trust, and helping others uncover ideas that strengthen collaboration and shared understanding.
configurations.leadershipStory: As a Connector, you naturally bring people together to discover new possibilities through meaningful relationships. You lead by creating space for dialogue, building trust, and helping others uncover ideas that strengthen collaboration and shared understanding.
configurations.howYouLead: Your leadership expands as you transform the ideas and possibilities you uncover into meaningful action, helping relationships become catalysts for lasting change.
configurations.expandingLeadershipContribution: Your leadership expands as you transform the ideas and possibilities you uncover into meaningful action, helping relationships become catalysts for lasting change.
configurations.helpOthers: Create space for honest dialogue and accountability.
configurations.increaseLeadershipEffectiveness: Take meaningful action on the ideas you uncover.
configurations.enduringQuestion: When is understanding sufficient to begin acting?

configurations.name: Cultivator
configurations.descriptiveLine: Helping others understand reality and grow with clarity.
configurations.shortDescription: Helping others understand reality and grow with clarity.
configurations.profile: As a Cultivator, you naturally understand people, systems, and the realities that shape them. You lead by building trust, developing others, and creating environments where individuals gain greater clarity, confidence, and capacity for growth.
configurations.leadershipStory: As a Cultivator, you naturally understand people, systems, and the realities that shape them. You lead by building trust, developing others, and creating environments where individuals gain greater clarity, confidence, and capacity for growth.
configurations.howYouLead: Your leadership expands as you transform deep understanding into courageous action, helping others move from greater clarity toward meaningful and lasting change.
configurations.expandingLeadershipContribution: Your leadership expands as you transform deep understanding into courageous action, helping others move from greater clarity toward meaningful and lasting change.
configurations.helpOthers: Create environments where others feel valued and supported.
configurations.increaseLeadershipEffectiveness: Move from understanding to courageous action.
configurations.enduringQuestion: What future becomes possible when I build upon what I already understand?

configurations.name: Catalyst
configurations.descriptiveLine: Creating momentum by moving people toward action.
configurations.shortDescription: Creating momentum by moving people toward action.
configurations.profile: As a Catalyst, you naturally move ideas into action with confidence and determination. You lead by mobilizing people, creating momentum, and helping teams make meaningful progress when decisive action is needed.
configurations.leadershipStory: As a Catalyst, you naturally move ideas into action with confidence and determination. You lead by mobilizing people, creating momentum, and helping teams make meaningful progress when decisive action is needed.
configurations.howYouLead: Your leadership expands as you deepen your understanding before taking action, ensuring momentum is guided by wisdom as well as determination.
configurations.expandingLeadershipContribution: Your leadership expands as you deepen your understanding before taking action, ensuring momentum is guided by wisdom as well as determination.
configurations.increaseLeadershipEffectiveness: Pause to deepen understanding before taking the next step.
configurations.enduringQuestion: How can deeper understanding strengthen the actions I take today?

configurations.name: Sensemaker
configurations.descriptiveLine: Bringing clarity to complexity through synthesis and perspective.
configurations.shortDescription: Bringing clarity to complexity through synthesis and perspective.
configurations.profile: As a Sensemaker, you naturally help people make sense of complexity by recognizing patterns, connecting ideas, and synthesizing diverse perspectives. You lead by creating shared understanding that helps others recognize emerging possibilities and move toward meaningful action.
configurations.leadershipStory: As a Sensemaker, you naturally help people make sense of complexity by recognizing patterns, connecting ideas, and synthesizing diverse perspectives. You lead by creating shared understanding that helps others recognize emerging possibilities and move toward meaningful action.
configurations.howYouLead: Your leadership expands as you pair broad perspective with intentional follow-through, transforming shared understanding into meaningful and sustained action.
configurations.expandingLeadershipContribution: Your leadership expands as you pair broad perspective with intentional follow-through, transforming shared understanding into meaningful and sustained action.
configurations.helpOthers: Build optimism and confidence during uncertainty.
configurations.increaseLeadershipEffectiveness: Turn your ideas into practical next steps for others.
configurations.enduringQuestion: What courageous action will move this possibility toward reality?

configurations.name: Stabilizer
configurations.descriptiveLine: Providing stability while creating conditions for growth.
configurations.shortDescription: Providing stability while creating conditions for growth.
configurations.profile: As a Stabilizer, you naturally value stability, consistency, and dependable leadership, helping people and organizations build trust over time. You create the trust and stability that allow people and organizations to grow through change without losing their core purpose.
configurations.leadershipStory: As a Stabilizer, you naturally value stability, consistency, and dependable leadership, helping people and organizations build trust over time. You create the trust and stability that allow people and organizations to grow through change without losing their core purpose.
configurations.howYouLead: Your leadership expands as you embrace new possibilities alongside trusted practices, helping stability become a foundation for continued growth and transformation.
configurations.expandingLeadershipContribution: Your leadership expands as you embrace new possibilities alongside trusted practices, helping stability become a foundation for continued growth and transformation.
configurations.helpOthers: Encourage shared responsibility for sustaining meaningful change.
configurations.increaseLeadershipEffectiveness: Take small actions even when the outcome is uncertain.
configurations.enduringQuestion: What new possibility is inviting me to grow beyond what is familiar?
